Tracker Installation Guide
Teltonika GPS × RentSyst
0 / 12

Set up your GPS tracker

Follow all 13 steps in order. Tick each checkbox, click Done to move forward. The guide has 3 parts: configure on PC, install in the vehicle, connect to RentSyst.

⚙ 1. Configure Steps 1–8 · on PC
🚘 2. Install Steps 9–10 · in vehicle
🔌 3. Connect Steps 11–12 · in RentSyst
⚙ Part 1 — Configure on PC · Steps 1–8
1
Read the User Manual for your tracker model
required ⌄

Find your model and open the manual — it contains the wiring diagram needed for installation.

FMB130· 2G tracker, most common
Manual ↗
FMM130· 4G LTE tracker
Manual ↗
FMM230· 4G waterproof tracker
Manual ↗
FMB003· 2G OBD plug-in, no wiring needed
Manual ↗
2
Insert SIM card and connect battery
required ⌄

Before inserting the SIM — write down the SIM phone number. You will need it in Step 12.

⚠ SIM must have mobile data enabled. Using your own SIM? Ask your provider for the correct APN.
3
Power on and connect to PC via USB
required ⌄

Power the tracker using the DC cable (10–30V). LED should start blinking — device is working. Connect Micro-USB to your Windows laptop.

Blinking every secondNormal — working ✓
Always onNo GPS signal yet
OffNot working / sleep mode
Blinking fastFirmware updating
4
Install and open Teltonika Configurator
required ⌄

Download and install the latest Teltonika Configurator on your Windows PC. Open it — your tracker should appear automatically. Click to connect.

⚠ Error “COM port is busy”? Close all other Configurator windows, unplug and replug the USB cable.

After connecting, the device appears in the list — click to open:

Main configuration screen (GPRS settings will be configured in Step 6):

5
Copy the tracker IMEI number
required ⌄

The IMEI is shown in the top-right corner of Configurator. Copy and save it — you will need it in Step 12. Can’t find it? Check the back label of the tracker.

6
Set GPRS settings
required ⌄

In Configurator open the GPRS tab. Enter these exact values:

APN
iot.truphone.com
Domain
tracker.rentsyst.com
Port
10100
Protocol
TCP
APN Usernameleave empty — do not fill
APN Passwordleave empty — do not fill
⚠ Using your own SIM? Replace APN with your mobile operator’s APN.
7
Set Data Protocol to Codec 8
required ⌄

Go to the System tab. Find Data Protocol and select Codec 8.

8
Check GSM signal and save to device
required ⌄

Open Status tab → GSM Info. All three must be green. Then click “Save to device”.

SIM → Ready
GPRS → Activated
Signal → not offline
Modem → ON
⚠ SIM shows “Not inserted”? Recheck the SIM card orientation in the slot.
🚘 Part 2 — Install in vehicle · Steps 9–10
9
Mount and wire the tracker in the vehicle
required ⌄

Connect tracker to vehicle power using the wiring diagram from Step 1. Mount it hidden — under dashboard or behind panels.

Watch installation video guides:

Teltonika Tracker Installation Guide
youtube.com
⚠ Must be installed by a qualified electrician. FMB003 (OBD) — simply plug into the OBD port, no wiring needed.
10
Connect relay for remote control
optional ⌄

Skip if you don’t need remote engine lock or door control. Connect a Vehicle Electrical Relay (12V, 5-pin, 20–50A).

DOUT 1Engine lock / unlock
DOUT 2Open doors
DOUT 3Close doors
🔌 Part 3 — Connect to RentSyst · Steps 11–12
11
Open vehicle profile and enter IMEI & SIM number
required ⌄

Log in to your RentSyst account and navigate to:

PathFleet → Vehicle → Specification → Edit

Find the Tracker IMEI and Tracker phone number fields. Enter the IMEI from Step 5 and the SIM phone number from Step 2. Save the changes.

⚠ Double-check the IMEI matches the correct vehicle. Each tracker must be linked to its own vehicle profile.
12
Start vehicle and verify on Dashboard
required ⌄

Turn on the ignition and let the vehicle run for 10–20 minutes. Open RentSyst Dashboard — your vehicle should appear on the map.

Color indication meaning on RentSyst Dashboard:

Red — live, sending data
Green — online, standby
Blue — selected on map
Black — vehicle offline (park mode)
⚠ Vehicle not showing? Recheck GPRS settings (Step 6), confirm SIM is active, drive the vehicle for at least 15–20 min.
